## Loading in the Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data <- read.csv("insurance.csv")
head(data)


```

Dimensions of the dataset

```{r}
dim(data)
```

The data set has 1338 rows and 7 different variables

Analysis

```{r}
# Look at the data types for each column
str(data)

# Get quick math summaries (min, max, mean) for numeric columns
summary(data)

```

Univariate analysis

```{r}
# Univariate analysis of the target variable (charges)
ggplot(data,aes(x = charges)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "seagreen", color = "black", bins = 40) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Medical Charges",
       x = "Medical Charges ($)",
       y = "Number of Patients") +
  theme_minimal()

```
